Every proposed row and every exclusion/disposition below requires evidenced approval before G1 closes.

### Proposed rows (474)

- **row** `api-fn:ANY:/api/telemetry/wizard` — lifecycle: **proposed** — evidence: Vercel function default export has no auth check; persona public (api/telemetry/wizard.ts:9)
- **row** `api:DELETE:/api/cashflow/:fundId/transactions/:transactionId` — lifecycle: **proposed** — evidence: Handler hard-deletes the transaction from the in-memory transactions Map after fund-scope check (server/routes/cashflow.ts:279-297), an irreversible removal of server-held state
- **row** `api:DELETE:/api/companies/:companyId/scenarios/:scenarioId` — lifecycle: **proposed** — evidence: server/routes/scenario-analysis.ts:981-990 registers the DELETE with requireAuth() and requireWriteRole(TEAM_WRITE_ROLES) (lines 983-984), which admits partner/admin/analyst.
- **row** `api:DELETE:/api/deals/opportunities/:id` — lifecycle: **proposed** — evidence: server/routes/deal-pipeline.ts:351-371 registers the handler with requireTeamWrite (requireWriteRole(TEAM_WRITE_ROLES) at :51, roles partner/admin/analyst) and idempotency middleware, then calls dealPipelineService.archiveDeal after resolveDealWriteScope.
- **row** `api:DELETE:/api/flags/admin/kill-switch` — lifecycle: **proposed** — evidence: server/routes/flags.ts:346-348 handler deletes process.env['FLAGS_DISABLED_ALL'], restoring flags; a reversible mutation of server-held state, no data removal.
